text:
anne-docs: Heads up — mkdocs linkcheck failed on staging build 4213. A bunch of anchors with emoji/ZWJ characters are flagged as broken.

anne-docs: Example error from linkcheck:
```
WARNING: broken link: /reference/auth#user👤-id -> fragment not found (404)
WARNING: broken link: /guides/migrate#step-2‍⚠️ -> fragment not found
```

mike-eng: Ugh. Those zero-width joiners/emoji are nasties. Do we have the original headings still in the markdown or did the Docusaurus/MkDocs slugifier change them during the migration?

anne-docs: The headings are unchanged in markdown (author used `### User 👤 ID` and `### Step 2‍⚠️`). MkDocs' slugify seems to strip ZWJ differently than the new docsite pipeline. Linkcheck compares the generated HTML ids to links that still have the emoji in them.

sam-frontend: Short term fix: make explicit header ids for those headings so slugs are deterministic. Example: `### User 👤 ID {#user-id}` and `### Step 2‍⚠️ {#step-2-warning}`. That avoids depending on slugifier behavior.

anne-docs: I opened a patch to add explicit ids and to normalize a couple of old links in content. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3521 (small md changes + test update). Can someone review?

jess-release: Taking this. Quick note — we should also add a linkcheck exception for legacy redirects for one week after merge so we don't regress other pages. I'll add a TODO comment in the PR. :+1:

deploy-bot: staging build triggered by jess-release on branch docs/explicit-ids (build 4214).

jess-release: Left a couple of inline comments — mostly nitty formatting and one place where we should prefer `{#user-id}` instead of HTML. Also added a small migration note in docs/CHANGELOG.md.

anne-docs: Pushed a follow-up commit that converts the HTML id suggestion to the markdown explicit id format and updated the broken links in /reference/auth. Commit: 8f3a2c9

deploy-bot: CI: docs linkcheck passed on build 4214. All green.

mike-eng: Can we backport this to v2 branch (the hosted-v2 docs still use the old slugifier)? We need matching anchors there or we'll get 404s when routing.

sam-frontend: I'll open the backport PR after lunch and add the redirect exceptions Jess mentioned.

anne-docs: Awesome — thanks everyone. Once backport is in I'll schedule a short redirect flush so CDN users see the fix quickly. :rocket:

jess-release: Merged main PR into main (3521) and tagged for backport. 

anne-docs: Confirmed: staging linkcheck now clean, and internal tests that parse anchors are happy. Closing the thread. :white_check_mark:
